items.title: Lundbeck to move US digs to Boston as it eyes bigger innovation frontiers
items.description: With Lundbeck steering its R&D engine toward increasingly specialized neuroscience targets, the Danish drugmaker is plotting a U.S. HQ move to one of the country’s preeminent biopharma hotspots.

items.title: Pioneer of China NewCo model sued in US over trade secret misuse, double-dealing
items.description: A legal feud unfolding in New York is putting a spotlight on the work of a business development veteran who is credited for pioneering one of biopharma’s hottest dealmaking mechanism: the China “NewCo” model.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Travere chief makes way for former Amicus CEO
items.description: Travere Therapeutics CEO Eric Dube, Ph.D., is stepping down after overseeing the launch of the rare kidney disease drug Filspari.

items.title: Indivior ends PAM drug collab with Addex ahead of Supernus merger
items.description: Ahead of its upcoming merger with Supernus, Indivior Pharmaceuticals has ended its long-running collaboration with Addex Therapeutics to develop positive allosteric modulators (PAMs).

items.title: Novo inks $1.3B Nanexa deal to unlock long-acting obesity injectables
items.description: Novo has struck a 1.17 billion euro ($1.3 billion) deal to combine Nanexa’s long-acting injectable drug delivery platform with its obesity and Type 2 diabetes drugs.

items.title: Roche's Genentech inks $1.5B bispecific pact with fast-rising Earendil
items.description: Roche’s Genentech is paying Earendil Labs $55 million upfront to discover and develop multiple bispecific antibodies. The deal, which focuses on oncology, includes milestones that could take the deal's value above $1.5 billion.
